subsystems.name: Telemetry collection
subsystems.role: gathers data from endpoints, network devices, cloud services and identity systems.

subsystems.name: Data pipeline and storage
subsystems.role: normalises, enriches and stores security events so models can query them at speed.

subsystems.name: Detection models
subsystems.role: flag anomalies and known malicious patterns across the telemetry.

subsystems.name: Attack simulation engine
subsystems.role: uses reinforcement learning to emulate attacker behaviour and discover exploitable paths.

subsystems.name: Correlation and triage
subsystems.role: fuses alerts, scores risk and builds investigation cases.

subsystems.name: Response orchestration
subsystems.role: carries out containment actions automatically or with approval.
parts: security orchestration, automation and response (SOAR) playbooks

subsystems.name: Analyst interface
subsystems.role: keeps a human in the loop to review, guide and correct the system.

buildSteps.title: Instrument the environment
buildSteps.detail: Deploy endpoint agents, network taps and cloud log connectors to capture events from every layer of the enterprise.

buildSteps.title: Centralise and normalise data
buildSteps.detail: Build a pipeline that parses, enriches with threat intelligence and stores events in a SIEM or data lake for fast querying.

buildSteps.title: Establish a behavioural baseline
buildSteps.detail: Train unsupervised models on weeks of normal activity so that deviations — unusual logins, data transfers or process chains — stand out.

buildSteps.title: Encode adversary behaviour
buildSteps.detail: Map known tactics and techniques (for example MITRE ATT&CK) into a simulated network model that the learning agents can explore.

buildSteps.title: Train reinforcement learning agents
buildSteps.detail: Let agents attempt to reach high-value targets in the simulation, rewarding them for finding new attack paths and vulnerabilities.

buildSteps.title: Fuse detection with simulation findings
buildSteps.detail: Combine real-time anomaly scores with patterns learned from simulated attacks to produce high-fidelity, context-rich alerts.

buildSteps.title: Connect to response tools
buildSteps.detail: Integrate the detection layer with SOAR, EDR and network controls so that validated threats can be contained quickly.

buildSteps.title: Test and tune
buildSteps.detail: Run red team / blue team exercises, measure false positives and false negatives, and adjust models and playbooks.

buildSteps.title: Deploy with human oversight
buildSteps.detail: Start with AI-assisted triage, expand autonomy as trust grows, and keep analysts able to review and override every automated action.

pathway.milestone: AI-assisted threat hunting: analysts use machine learning to prioritise alerts and surface suspicious activity
pathway.unlocks: faster triage and reduced alert fatigue.

pathway.milestone: Autonomous detection and investigation: agents correlate alerts across sources and suggest next steps
pathway.unlocks: analysts focus on complex cases while routine hunting runs continuously.

pathway.milestone: Closed-loop response with human approval: validated threats are contained automatically under supervision
pathway.unlocks: containment in seconds rather than hours.

pathway.milestone: Fully autonomous threat hunting and response: systems proactively seek and neutralise threats at machine speed
pathway.unlocks: defence that keeps pace with automated attacks.
